issues.detail: The Hebrew 'חִנָּם מְזֹרָה הָרָשֶׁת' means 'in vain is the net spread' (i.e., the net is spread in vain), referring to a net spread without cause. The Chinese renders '窮人所撒的網' ('the net spread by the poor'), introducing '窮人' (poor) which is not in the Hebrew. The subject is the net, not a person, and there is no mention of 'poor' or 'poor people' in the verse.
